import resource
resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CORE,(0,0))
import json, os, torch
import scglue
print(json.dumps({'stage':'imports','visible_devices':os.environ.get('CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES'),'cuda':torch.version.cuda}),flush=True)
assert torch.cuda.is_available()
torch.cuda.get_rng_state_all()
torch.cuda.synchronize()
print('initial CUDA/RNG synchronized',flush=True)
from scglue.models.sc import GraphEncoder, GraphDecoder, NBDataDecoder
from ignite.handlers import TerminateOnNan
from types import SimpleNamespace
x=torch.ones((4,8),dtype=torch.float32).pin_memory()
print('CPU pin_memory complete',flush=True)
x=x.to('cuda',non_blocking=True)
torch.cuda.synchronize()
print('nonblocking pinned transfer synchronized',flush=True)
eidx=torch.stack((torch.arange(8,device='cuda'),torch.arange(8,device='cuda').roll(1)))
weights=torch.ones(8,device='cuda')
encoder=GraphEncoder(8,3).to('cuda')
posterior=encoder(eidx,weights,weights)
torch.cuda.synchronize()
print('native GraphConv scatter_add synchronized',flush=True)
v=posterior.rsample()
graph_loss=-GraphDecoder()(v,eidx,weights).log_prob(torch.ones(8,device='cuda')).mean()
positive=torch.zeros(2,device='cuda')
positive.scatter_add_(0,torch.arange(8,device='cuda')%2,torch.arange(8,device='cuda',dtype=torch.float32))
torch.cuda.synchronize()
print('native graph decoder and loss scatter synchronized',flush=True)
u=torch.ones((4,3),device='cuda',requires_grad=True)
decoder=NBDataDecoder(8).to('cuda')
nb=decoder(u,v,torch.zeros(4,device='cuda',dtype=torch.long),torch.ones((4,1),device='cuda')*8)
loss=graph_loss-nb.log_prob(x).mean()
loss.backward()
torch.cuda.synchronize()
print('NB loss and graph backward synchronized',flush=True)
TerminateOnNan()(SimpleNamespace(state=SimpleNamespace(output={'loss':loss}),terminate=lambda:None))
assert bool(torch.isfinite(loss))
print(json.dumps({'stage':'native kernels complete','loss':float(loss),'gradient_finite':bool(torch.isfinite(encoder.vrepr.grad).all())}),flush=True)
